conditions: The rule concerns variable reference forms in the MDC/28 static-syntax description.
limitations: Storage layout, sharing and persistence require separate evidence.

triggers: Archive correction, edition or date dispute, or new contrary primary evidence.

statement: The March 1975 MDC/28 narrative permits both unsubscripted and subscripted forms of local and global variable names. The caret prefix designates a global variable name, and an unsubscripted occurrence may have a different value from a subscripted occurrence of the same name.
